resources.string: Share one folder from this phone with ChatGPT. You can chat on your phone or tablet. Files stay on this phone until a connected AI reads them.

In a new Termux session on this phone, run the copied command. Paste the HTTPS address it prints below. Keep that session running. For a named tunnel, use a separate MCP hostname pointing to this phone’s port 8787.
Choose a profile name and password. The connection page must sign in with both before a request reaches this phone. Phone approval is still required.
Leave blank to keep current password
Enter a profile name of 1 to 64 characters.
Use a password of 8 to 128 characters.
The two passwords do not match.
Create and confirm a password before starting.
Allow AI to create converted copies
AI can list folders and read UTF-8 txt, md and json files up to 1 MiB. Conversion creates new copies. It cannot overwrite or delete originals. Stop ends access and revokes all active connections.
Sharing your chosen folder. Tap to approve connections or stop.
Could not start. Check folder access, the HTTPS address, and that port 8787 is free.

Copy the MCP address into a custom MCP connection in ChatGPT, using OAuth. Sign in on the connection page with the profile and password set above. Then return here and approve only the request whose code matches that page. Return to the page and tap Continue. Keep this phone online. Hosting keeps this phone awake and uses battery. Stop it when you finish sharing. Restarting revokes active connections; reconnect ChatGPT afterwards.
Forget registered AI clients on this phone? Remove and recreate the MCP connection in ChatGPT afterwards. Your files are unaffected.
Saved connections cleared. Recreate the connection in ChatGPT.
Stop the AI connection before changing the shared folder.
List folders and read text files
List folders, read text files, and create converted copies
Approved · return to the connection page
Convert a file on this phone

Works while the AI connection is stopped too. Markdown to text removes formatting. Text to Markdown uses a literal text block. JSON stores format and text so it can be converted back. Other JSON is formatted as readable text or a Markdown code block.
Enter an HTTPS tunnel address without /mcp or another path.
Enter a new filename without a folder path or extension.
Could not open the folder. Choose it again and grant access. Folders may contain up to 500 direct entries.
Could not convert. Check that the source is valid UTF-8 text under 1 MiB, JSON is valid, and the destination name is unused.
